headline: The redesign is faithful and the money and Undo behaviours I walked hold, but the suite does not pin its structure (4 of 9 probes survived), Review > claim due is a dead end, and Home scrolls with a health bar or the Payday card. No Blocker.

suites.e2e: 720/720 pass (sweep, 51 min); my 119 walk tests: 93 pass, 26 fail = 24 Home-fit combos (capture-off, payday) + the chip-row test + the first-cycle strip check, all findings or notes
suites.lint: clean (after my qa/ files were tidied)

findings.title: Four of eight deliberate defects stayed green: the redesign's structure and two money behaviours are untested
findings.detail: Probes on the project suite (apps/web/e2e, and unit) run against QA's dev server. Caught: Home height, Apply-all double tap, messaging apps selectable, money arithmetic (apportion float + no-float lint). NOT caught: (a) Review answer chips changed from size chip (32) to default; (b) balance check difference text swapped (more/less); (c) txn Delete no longer offers Undo; (d) Settings > Appearance row hard-coded to Minted. The chip size is the exact bug D130 set out to fix, and the suite only checks targets are at least 48 px, which a bigger button also passes.
findings.repro: sed one line, then `playwright test -c qa/e2e/b04r-probe.config.ts <spec>`; see probes
findings.evidence: rows.tsx size="chip"->"default": 61 passed. balance-form.tsx less/more swapped: 2 passed. txn.tsx delete {quiet:true}: 2 passed. settings.tsx value="Minted": 12 passed
findings.spec: AC-13, AC-23s, AC-4s, AC-5s; CLAUDE.md money

findings.title: Review "claim due" opens a claim that does not exist
findings.detail: In Review > Checks, tapping "<scheme> claim · RMxx" goes to /s/claim with no id, so the screen says "Not here any more. This claim isn't here any more." The review item carries no claim id. Present on origin/main too (go('claim') at review.tsx), but the redesign rebuilt that row and the dead end remains in a core path (flows `claims` step 3).
findings.repro: Review tab > the "Phone bill claim" card (Checks) > tap
findings.evidence: url http://127.0.0.1:5291/s/claim | "Not here any more / This claim isn't here any more. / See all claims"

findings.title: Home scrolls in the two states that add a bar or card: capture off (63-80 px) and payday (81-92 px), and Sen's button then covers the Gap amount

findings.title: Review answer rows can be scrolled vertically by 6 px
findings.detail: The chip row is overflow-x-auto, so overflow-y becomes auto too; the 48 px tap extension makes scrollHeight 42 against clientHeight 36. A finger on the row can nudge it.
findings.evidence: sh=42 ch=36 on 10 rows (b04r-core FLOW-3s fails with max extra 6)

findings.title: Progress bars announce no value
findings.detail: Claims month bar and the Members seat meter have role progressbar with aria-valuemax 100 but no aria-valuenow, so a screen reader hears no figure. They are named (label) but the value only exists in the visible text.
